findings.issue: `qualified_declarations`'s `extra_declarations` parameter and its `kind == "extra"` branch (line 489-491) are dead: the only caller is `own_declaration_paths` (line 520), which never passes it, and no test touches it — `grep -rn "extra_declarations" scripts/ .github/` matches only the definition. Its contract is asserted only by docstring: extras bypass `keep`, sort after same-position declarations, and are indistinguishable from parsed declarations in the returned `set`, which also discards positions and duplicates (so a consumer needing line numbers, as the lint itself does, cannot use this walk).

summary: The parser extraction is behavior-preserving: the moved code is textually identical apart from the `_update_scope` rename, and the rewritten `own_declaration_paths` is equivalent to the old namespace walk. The only unverified addition is the `extra_declarations` hook on `qualified_declarations`, which has no producer, no consumer, and no test.
